datasets.description: FLEX (Flame Extinguishment Experiment, ISS Combustion Integrated Rack / MDCA) Table IX rows FLEX-001 to FLEX-010, transcribed as printed from NASA/TP-2015-216046 Appendix A, printed page 20 (PDF page 26). Transcribed from PDF sha256 b4f6ca983e2792c33a0b92220a791a818f426bb635b94f7fd33dc8c9c471e79d; every cell checked by eye against a 250-dpi render and by tools/verify_flex_table_ix.py against the PDF text layer. Empty cell = printed en dash (listed per row in source_dash_fields); a printed 0 is kept as 0. Limitations: (1) ISS microgravity, free-floating droplets, near-ambient temperature; rows 1-9 near 1 atm air, row 10 about 3 atm O2/N2/CO2. (2) Report section 5.2: all tests in this report used conformally coated fuel needles; droplets contained an unknown amount of coating; methanol disruptive extinction is probably contaminant-driven and heptane disruption may be. (3) FLEX-001 to FLEX-009 used a 1/30 s shutter; droplet size near ignition is ambiguous. FLEX-002 to FLEX-006 are described as calibration runs in their Appendix B captions (identifiers of FLEX-001 to FLEX-009 contain CAL). (4) Per Appendix A.1 a dash in the extinction-diameter column means no extinction (disruption or completion) or not listed because the droplet left the HiBMs field of view; extinction diameters were extrapolated for droplets that left the HiBMs FOV before extinction; the printed table does not mark which. Captions for FLEX-001, -002, -003 and -005 say the droplet stayed in view; FLEX-006 drifted out and back, so its value may be extrapolated. (5) FLEX-010: Table IX prints a burning rate of .37 but the Figure 14 caption says no burning rate constant is reported; the table value is kept as printed and flagged, not resolved. (6) Mole fractions are printed to two decimals and are initial ambient values. Per-cell exclusion and caution flags with verbatim source quotes: manifest entry nasa-tp-2015-216046.table-ix.flex-001-010.flags. Details: data/docs/flex_table_ix.md.

datasets.description: FlameGuard-SI usage flags for the FLEX Table IX extract (generated by FlameGuard-SI, not NASA). One row per flag: test, field ('*' = whole row), flag type, ranking_use (exclude | caution | not_available), reason, and the printed page plus verbatim quote from NASA/TP-2015-216046 that supports it. Key rules: FLEX-010 burning rate is disputed and excluded from rankings until resolved (value kept as printed in the measured file); every printed dash is flagged not_available and must never be read as zero or as a confirmed no-extinction event; imaging, possible-extrapolation, contamination and calibration caveats are cautions. Flags do not modify any measured value.
datasets.method: Manual review of NASA/TP-2015-216046 (Sections 5.1-5.2, Appendix A.1, Appendix B captions for Figures 5-14) by the feat/nasa-data-tars workstream on 2026-11-14. Each flag cites a printed page and verbatim quote; tools/verify_flex_table_ix.py checks the quotes against the PDF and that every printed dash is flagged.
